name: OSS_USAGE_REQUEST_MESSAGES_T
description: Following table is used to capture ess job request process information.

columns.name: USAGE_REQUEST_MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture unique identifier of rating request message.

columns.name: RATING_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture rating request identifier.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ROOT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the requested id of ess job, submitted by user.

columns.name: PARENT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the parent requested id associated with the usage rating job.

columns.name: WORKER_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture usage event batch worker identifier.

columns.name: WORKER_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture usage event batch worker unit identifier.

columns.name: PARTITION_KEY
columns.description: Column used for persisting the value of partition key for child entity tables.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TEXT
columns.description: Field used to capture ess job message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TYPE
columns.description: Field used to capture ess job message, ie. ORA_ERROR/ORA_WANRING/ORA_INFO.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
